items.title: Google Confirms 90 Zero-Day Vulnerabilities Actively Exploited in 2025
items.description: The Google Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG) released its annual analysis, confirming that 90 zero-day vulnerabilities were actively exploited in the wild throughout 2025.
